units.source_text: 源氏公子读后想道：“我虽然想念她，但这个人心肠异常强硬，竟非别人可比；

en.t: After reading it, Prince Genji thought, "Although I miss her, this person's heart is extraordinarily unyielding, beyond comparison with anyone else;
and now at last she has gone far away."

units.source_text: 今日适值立冬，天公似欲向人明示，降了一番时雨，景象清幽沉寂。

en.t: Today happened to be the beginning of winter, and as if Heaven wished to make it plain to people, a passing shower fell, leaving the scene pure, quiet, and still.

units.source_text: 源氏公子镇日沉思遐想，独自吟道：

en.t: Prince Genji spent the whole day sunk in wandering thoughts, and alone he recited:
